question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**hue**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the life cycle of a Banana.
 
• Now, the blank 3 will imply the greenish color that the fruit gets due to the presence of chlorophyll.
 
• Among the given options, the correct word to use is** "hue."**
 
 
• **"Hue"** refers to the color of something.(रंग)
 
• It is often used to describe a specific shade or tone of color.
 
 
• **Example**: *"The artist used a deep, rich **hue**__ of blue in her painting."*
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.
 
• Correct passage:

The life __cycle__ of a banana is a colourful one; it starts with a deep green, changes to a delicious yellow and ends at an unappetizing brown. Bananas, like most fruits, produce and __react__ with an airborne hormone called ethylene. This hormone helps to signal the ripening process. An unripe fruit is hard and acidic. It is likely to possess a greenish __**hue**__ due to the presence of chlorophyll. When a fruit comes into contact ______ (4) ______ ethylene, the acids in the fruit start to break down, it becomes softer and the green chlorophyll is ______ (5) ______ and replaced, in the case of bananas, with a yellow hue. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "seed"**, refers to the small, hard part of a plant that can grow into a new plant.(बीज)
 
• **Option 2, "flesh"**, refers to the soft, edible part of a fruit or vegetable.(माँस)
 
• **Option 3, "fibre"**, refers to the thread-like strands that make up the tissues of plants or animals.(रेशा)
